purpose: Teach: サンバ/ボビー/パトリック/クリストファー/リンダ/アーク/アナン/サドル

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、サンバのリズムが大好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi mentioned her customer loves samba rhythms.
lines.style: Soft, observant tone. Pause as if recalling a detail from earlier conversation. Gentle warmth—noticing what the customer shared. No urgency, just sharing a memory with affection.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ボビー・ブラウンのファンだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi said her customer is a Bobby Brown fan.
lines.style: Same reflective baseline. A slight smile in the voice—amused at the specificity. Speaking as if to herself and Mei equally. Pace remains unhurried, intimate.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、パトリック・スウェイジの映画にハマってるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi mentioned her customer has gotten into Patrick Swayze movies.
lines.style: The rhythm of observation continues. Small warmth on "gotten into"—recognizing how the customer's tastes matter. Still the barista noticing her regulars' worlds. Conversational, unforced.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、クリストファー・ノーランの映画を観てこられたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Her customer went to see a Christopher Nolan film recently, Aoi said.
lines.style: A beat of pride in the voice—the customer went and did the thing. Aoi sharing this like it mattered. Warm but grounded. The tone of someone who tracks what people care about and is glad when they follow through.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、リンダ・カーター主演のドラマがお好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi mentioned her customer loves dramas with Linda Carter.
lines.style: Slight nostalgia in the air. The kind of affection you have for someone's small, specific joy. Voice stays low and present. A pause before speaking, as if the memory just surfaced.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、フランスのアーク・ド・トリオンフを見に行かれたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Her customer went to see the Arc de Triomphe in France, apparently.
lines.style: A lift of delight in the voice—the customer traveled. Aoi is genuinely happy about this. Slower pace on the place name, as if picturing it. Warm and present, not distant.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、コフィー・アナン氏の伝記を読んでらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi's customer has been reading a biography of Kofi Annan.
lines.style: Respectful pause before the name. Genuine interest in what the customer chooses to learn about. Voice takes on slight weight—this is meaningful. Not performative, just genuine care for the customer's inner life.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、自転車のサドルを買い替えられたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Her customer replaced her bicycle saddle, Aoi mentioned.
lines.style: Warmth fades slightly—smaller detail, practical care. Voice settles into contentment rather than fascination. A trailing softness at the end, like this detail is the last one, and it's enough. Intimate close.
